name: zinterp_context_destructor
description: zInterp_Context::Destructor installs the base vtable marker, calls Destroy, frees constructor-owned allocations, deletes the scroll sentinel, and clears scroll-list state.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zInterp parser/runtime source-cluster pass.
The source uses a symbolic vtable marker instead of the original raw image vtable address; tier S class/source-cluster work must replace this with the final rebuilt vtable symbol.
Binary Ninja renders compiler SEH setup and the scroll-always sentinel-list loop condition as explicit compiler artifacts; source uses the equivalent original-era destructor structure.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4c0e50 validates compiler EH setup through 0x4cb9de, assigning the zInterp_Context vtable, calling Destroy, freeing tempAlloc, runtimeBlob, preparedEntryCount, preparedEntryTable, preparedIndexFileName, and searchPathSpec when present, deleting any remaining scroll nodes, deleting the scroll sentinel head, and clearing scrollAlwaysListHead and scrollAlwaysListCount.

The native smoke verifies the destructor path against allocated constructor-owned fields, an archive search path, pointer array, and scroll sentinel; after destruction the vtable marker is installed and scroll/pointer/include state is cleared.
